## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

2. Which sectors are leading?

Major divergence note: multiple large-cap names (JPM, BLK, LRCX etc.) show 1W up vs 1M down — tactical signals, watch for follow-through rather than redefining core exposure.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

8. Financials Outlook?

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names mixed and trending lower overall: PFE (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND sits apart while LLY (1W: -6.11% | 1M: -10.10%) BELOW TREND and ABBV (1W: -8.49% | 1M: -9.83%) BELOW TREND show material weakness; sector performance: Healthcare 1W: -1.85% | 1M: -6.53% (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and resilient software/financial names: XOM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +9.56%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.86%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to broad Tech leaders showing structural weakness (AAPL (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -5.82%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -2.43%) BELOW TREND) and lagging Materials (NEM (1W: -13.35% | 1M: -20.28%) BELOW TREND).

AAPL (1W: -2.66% | 1M: -5.82%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize on weekly timeframe would confirm further downside. JPM (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -6.74%) RECOVERY — sustained weekly strength would validate financials’ recovery theme.

ADBE (-55): negative AI narrative; ADBE (1W: -8.82% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. ## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and leadership is broad but shallow. XOM (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +4.96%) ABOVE TREND and INTU (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.86%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (multiple majors with 1W ≠ 1M) and bullish headlines (e.g., LLY) diverging from price — watch for trend confirmation.
